plugins.name: unotes
plugins.description: Study from Claude with uNotes, read-only: find course notes, past exams, and lab reports in the uNotes library, turn documents into study guides and practice questions, and plan revision from your flashcards, quizzes, and streak.

skills.name: building-study-guides
skills.description: Turns one or more uNotes documents into a study guide, summary, cheat sheet, or practice questions in the chat, and quizzes the user on them. Use when the user asks to 'make me a study guide from this document', 'summarize these notes', 'make a cheat sheet', 'quiz me on my Operating Systems notes', 'create practice questions', or 'help me study for my exam' from uNotes material. Nothing is saved to uNotes.
headings: Build a study guide from uNotes documents

skills.name: planning-revision
skills.description: Builds a revision plan from the user's uNotes flashcard decks, quizzes, study streak, and monthly quota. Use when the user asks 'what should I revise', 'which flashcards do I have', 'which quizzes are on my courses', 'how long is my study streak', 'did I study today', 'make a revision plan for my exam', or 'how much uNotes quota is left'. Read-only.

skills.name: researching-course-material
skills.description: Searches the uNotes study library for course material such as past exams, assignments, lab reports, and lecture notes, and answers questions from the documents with each source named. Use when the user asks to 'find uNotes documents about virtual memory in CSI 3131', 'find past exams for this course', 'what do the lecture notes cover', 'search study notes for a topic', 'find class notes on', or wants exam prep material or a sourced answer from uNotes. Read-only.

skills.name: setup-unotes
skills.description: Connects the uNotes MCP server to Claude and verifies it with one read-only call: where to connect in claude.ai, Claude Desktop, Cowork, or Claude Code, what the uNotes sign-in and consent screen asks, and how to recover when a tool is missing. Use when the user asks to 'set up uNotes', 'connect uNotes to Claude', 'install the uNotes connector', 'sign in to uNotes', 'why can't Claude see my uNotes data', 'uNotes tools are missing', or reports 'Tool not found' for a uNotes tool.
